text.headline: Timeline of the United Arab Emirates
text.text: Major events in the history of the United Arab Emirates.

events.headline: Early Arab Settlements
events.text: Tribal confederations inhabit the Gulf coast, trading and pearl diving.

events.headline: Portuguese Arrival
events.text: Portuguese establish forts and trading posts in the Gulf.

events.headline: Trucial States
events.text: Britain signs maritime truces with local rulers, creating the Trucial States.

events.headline: Discovery of Oil
events.text: Oil discoveries transform the economy and infrastructure.

events.headline: UAE Formed
events.text: Six emirates unite; Ras Al Khaimah joins in 1972.

events.headline: GCC Founded
events.text: The UAE is a founding member of the Gulf Cooperation Council.

events.headline: Sheikh Zayed’s Passing
events.text: Founding father Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan is succeeded by Sheikh Khalifa.

events.headline: 50th Anniversary
events.text: Expo 2020 Dubai and Golden Jubilee celebrations.

events.headline: Space & Energy Leadership
events.text: UAE advances in space, trade, and renewables.
